fieldValues.title: Agents affirm problems held by an agent persona, under evidence the owner can overturn
fieldValues.move: An agent may affirm a problem only when it is held by an AI-agent persona-in-domain, and only with evidence from agent use (a bench task it fails, a usage stat, a recorded incident), cited on the affirmation and stamped with the agent's createdBy. The affirmation is a fork into Affirmed like the owner's, marked as agent-affirmed; the owner can overturn it in the affirmation layer at any time, and an owner affirmation or set-aside always wins. Remedies, domains and rulings stay the owner's.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: It does not let agents affirm problems held by a human persona, remedies or rulings, and it does not settle which agent may affirm (any session, or only a chartered seat).
fieldValues.falsifier: The owner overturns more than one in five agent affirmations in a period, or an agent-affirmed problem is found to have no evidence from agent use.
